subject: Marketplace private offer — stakeholder map, term options, and co-sell credits
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avabiotech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private offer — stakeholder map, term options, and co-sell credits

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great alignment on the migration pattern and the expected inference throughput. To make progress on the AWS Marketplace private offer (MPO) we need to lock two things: the buyer-side approval matrix and the term/pricing options we’ll present in the MPO.

Quick proposal from our side:
- Term options: 12mo (standard), 24mo (preferred discount), 36mo (enterprise rate with consumption floors)
- Target co-sell credit: either 10% or 15% depending on term/commitment (we’ll request co-sell routing via AWS GTM)
- Marketplace invoice flow: buyer issues PO to AWS (Marketplace), AWS invoices monthly; Redwood invoices AWS per MPO terms — procurement/finance please confirm this expectation on your end.

Could you confirm the internal approvers we should map for the MPO? Typical buyer gates we see:
- Budget owner (Product)
- Procurement (PO + payment terms)
- Legal (EULA + indemnity/DP terms)
- Security (SOC2, data handling signoff)

If you can share a short stakeholder map and the preferred term length, I’ll coordinate on our side and draft the MPO pricing matrix + a SOW for DocuSign. I’ve attached a starter pricing matrix and an SOW template for your review.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mpo-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), ava-sow-draft-2028.docx (SOW template)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avabiotech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@avabiotech.com>, procurement@avabiotech.com
Date: 2028-05-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — stakeholder map, term options, and co-sell credits

Hi Vivek — thanks, this is helpful.

We prefer a 24-month term as our procurement cycle favors multi-year commits to hit budget amortization. Key notes from our side:
- Internal approvers:
  - Emma Liu (VP Product) — budget owner
  - Procurement (procurement@avabiotech.com) — PO and payment terms
  - Daniel Park (Legal) — contract / term exceptions
  - Security (sec-approvals@avabiotech.com) — needs SOC2 Type II evidence and an outline of data isolation controls
- Procurement preference: AWS Marketplace MPO is fine, but they require clear billing cadence and evidence that Redwood will accept AWS PO terms (we can escalate if legal needs changes)
- Co-sell: AWS GTM coordination is welcome but co-sell credit target must be explicit in MPO submission. We typically see 12–18% core credit for platform deals; internal goal is to maximize GTM support but procurement will not accept credits that complicate pricing transparency.

I attached our standard vendor security checklist and a copy of our SOC2 intake request. Can you also confirm the escalation path and who will be the single internal contact for MPO ops? I’d like Redwood to nominate a single point of contact for procurement and legal.

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Procurement, Ava Biotech

Attachments: soc2-type2-2027-summary.pdf (vendor requested), ava-security-checklist.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — stakeholder map, term options, and co-sell credits

Vivek / Ben — looping in next steps and internal asks.

Notes / actions:
- Confirmed MPO term to propose: 24 months (per buyer). We should present 12/24/36 as options but flag 24 as recommended.
- Pricing: Ben to prepare a final pricing matrix that maps list price, MPO discount, and resulting per-inference unit cost for 12/24/36. Add a column showing net revenue after AWS marketplace fees.
- Co-sell: I’ll start the AWS GTM intake (we should request 15% with justification: GTM co-funding for joint field activities). If AWS pushes back, accept 12% as fallback.
- Legal exceptions: Daniel Park asked about indemnity caps and data residency note. Ben, can you prep the short exceptions doc and we’ll align with Legal.
- Security: I attached the SOC2 summary Samira sent; product security will do a quick questionnaire turn-around by EOD tomorrow.
- MPO ops POC: Recommend Vivek be primary POC for MPO creation and coordination; Vanessa will be backup for GTM/partner ops.

Attachments: soc2-type2-2027-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Marketplace & Partner Ops
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avabiotech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T14:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — stakeholder map, term options, and co-sell credits

Samira — thanks for the clarity. Confirming next steps and timelines so we’re all aligned: 

1) MPO package we will submit (ETA: 48 hours):
   - MPO draft with 12/24/36 options (clearly call out recommended 24mo with X% discount)
   - Pricing matrix showing list vs MPO net and post-AWS-fee revenue 
   - Explicit co-sell credit request: 15% (12% fallback) with short GTM plan attached
2) Legal/procurement path (owner: Ben / Vivek)
   - Ben will surface any term exceptions we expect the buyer to ask for (indemnity, termination for convenience window) in the MPO metadata so AWS reviewers can pre-check.
3) Security (owner: Product Security)
   - We’ve received the SOC2 summary you sent; product security will complete the checklist early tomorrow and escalate anything blocking.
4) MPO ops and POC
   - Vivek will be the single POC for procurement and AWS MPO ops (email: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com). Vanessa will run the AWS GTM intake and track co-sell approval.

Links & docs: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/456789/deal/RDW-2028-AVB-412 
DocuSign SOW (draft) will be shared by end of week: https://docusign.com/link/placeholder/ds-AVA-412

Samira — if procurement agrees to the MPO flow above, we’ll generate the private offer and send the DocuSign SOW for signature. If Legal needs any redlines ahead of MPO submission, please loop Daniel and we’ll triage immediately.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mpo-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx, ava-sow-draft-2028.docx, soc2-type2-2027-summary.pdf
